verdict.rationale: No official documentation addresses item caps or performance characteristics at scale for monday.com; the evidence pack contains no first-party engineering docs on limits. Independent community reports (e.g., Cassandra/Redis backend struggling to fetch 5,000 items in several seconds, general slowness complaints) actually suggest performance degrades with large datasets, but there is no vendor claim to compare against, so this is an unaddressed axis rather than a disputed one.
